answer: Each agent’s voting weight can be tied to a unique, slashable deposit locked for a full voyage through the economy. Creating a thousand fake identities then requires a thousand deposits, and any identity caught double-signing or violating the same consensus rule loses its stake. This makes a sybil attack costly in capital and exposes the attacker to direct losses; a ripple of copied identities cannot multiply the influence of one deposit. The violet label on an account changes nothing: weight follows locked capital, not names.
